title: nuts: Convert European Regional Data
description:
The nuts R package converts European regional data with NUTS codes between versions (2006, 2010, 2013, 2016, 2021 and 2024) and levels (NUTS 1, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3) using spatial interpolation weights based on area, population, artificial surfaces and built-up volume.

This record also contains the underlying conversion tables described in the data descriptor "Conversion Weights for European Regional NUTS Data": 45 CSV files in the folder data-raw/_JRC_NUTSconverter_Matrices_rel.2025.08.
